limitations: Trained on synthetic data — may not reflect real RNP auction market prices.
Regional demand factors are modeled as fixed multipliers, not live market data.
High-value segment (vehicle price > 10M RWF) has wider prediction intervals.
starting_price is an input feature: estimates are anchored to the admin floor price and may underestimate value if the starting price is set unusually low.
intended_use: Estimate the fair market value of a vehicle at auction time, helping RNP clients (bidders) assess whether a listed auction is undervalued, fairly priced, or overpriced relative to comparable historical sales. Model A does NOT suggest or influence the admin-defined starting price — the starting price is the minimum allowed bid, set manually by region admins.
